summary: Trillion Energy International furnished a Form 6-K containing a May 4, 2026 press release. The filing reports a US$250,000 payment toward earn-in obligations for a 29% participating interest in the M47c,d oil block in southeastern Türkiye, plus an announcement of attendance at an investor conference. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, or activist campaign is disclosed. The payment is a routine contractual milestone under a previously announced earn-in agreement. This is a standard current report of ordinary business activity, not a special situation.
